description: This Java source file defines a test class 'TombstoneTransmitTest' that verifies the tombstone transfer feature on Cuttlefish devices. It includes methods for generating tombstones of varying sizes, checking their integrity, and managing tombstone files on the device. The class uses the Trade Federation testing framework and JUnit annotations to structure the tests.

classes.name: TombstoneTransmitTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the tombstone transfer functionality on Cuttlefish devices, including generating, transferring, and validating tombstones.

methods.name: testTombstonesOfVaryingLengths
methods.description: Creates tombstones of increasing sizes, then verifies that the host and guest tombstone lists match and contain the expected number of entries.

methods.name: testTombstoneTransmitIntegrity
methods.description: Triggers multiple tombstones creation, then verifies the integrity and count of tombstones on both host and guest.

methods.name: printTombstoneListStats
methods.description: Prints statistics about a list of tombstones, including count and average size.

methods.name: clearTombstonesFromCuttlefish
methods.description: Removes all tombstone files from the device to prepare for tests.

methods.name: getTombstonesViaAdb
methods.description: Retrieves tombstone files from the device via ADB.

methods.name: convertFileListToStringList
methods.description: Converts a list of File objects to a list of their string contents.

methods.name: convertFileContentsToString
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: generateTombstoneOfLengthInKb
methods.description: Creates a tombstone file of specified size in kilobytes on the device.
